The serial number, IDPS and OpenPSID of this console are about to be shown.

toolbox.migration_notice.title: Moved over from OnionHEN
toolbox.migration_notice.body:
An existing OnionHEN installation was found on this console.

Your settings, payloads, plugins and cheats were copied from /data/OnionHEN to /data/AniketosHEN. The OnionHEN folder was not changed or deleted, so you can go back to OnionHEN at any time.

The copy is made only once. From now on AniketosHEN uses its own folder only; you can delete /data/OnionHEN yourself when you no longer need it.
